question: Three of the following four letter - clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

**The logic followed here is :- **

 
• **First and second letter - Difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (5).**
 
• **First and third letter - Opposite letter pairs according to English alphabetic series****.**

**​**So,

 
• Option - (1) : HMS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0cbb1768bae7eb500d39f077788e5df78be4fc76cb106aefb230a148ffd8be8.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : AFZ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07465c92f48d6bc1ed3a5610a51baa43a25efb688835d657278987d687749800.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : KQP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc85d3fb8d723f99da4b011adfa901198ad6eb9426026be2e7c46ee836db626.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : DIW

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbe75c0954cedf2fb577a114346204095ec500e439cafe94959e8b4021584323.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'KQP' is the odd one out as the difference between first and the second letter (6) respectively.

​Hence, "KQP" is the correct answer.
